slice-master.title: Slice Master - Precision Slicing Game
slice-master.description: Slice Master is a casual one-person game where precision, timing, and discernment are key. Slice through objects to rack up a high score and unlock new blades and skins. Play Slice Master now and experience the thrill of slicing!

HomeFeatures.whatIsDescription: Slice Master is a casual one-person game whose goal is to slice everything in sight, well, almost everything. This one-button game is driven by precision, timing, and discernment to rack up a high score.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep1: Use the mouse to aim your knife.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep3: Score points by slicing accurately and quickly.
HomeFeatures.feature1Description: Master the art of precision slicing to score high.
HomeFeatures.feature2Description: Progress through the game to unlock new blades.
HomeFeatures.feature3Description: Face increasingly difficult levels and obstacles.
HomeFeatures.feature4Description: Enjoy a relaxing yet challenging one-button game.
